opportunity.noticeType: Solicitation (Commercial Solutions Opening area of interest)
opportunity.description: Defense Health Agency PAE Digital Medical Solutions, EIDS PMO, seeks commercial solutions for Data Exchange Platform (DxP) operations, sustainment, modernization and development. The DxP processes real-time clinical and operational data exchanged with more than 15 external systems and partners and enables secure, standards-based interoperability among DHA, the Department of Veterans Affairs and other federal healthcare partners. The Government wants reliable, secure, continuously available legacy services while modernizing toward scalable, cloud-native, API-driven, standards-based and AI/ML-ready capabilities. Issued under DHA Commercial Solutions Opening HT003826SC005. No set-aside used.

supportedClaims.text: The opportunity is issued by the Defense Health Agency's Program Acquisition Executive for Digital Medical Solutions (PAE DMS), EIDS PMO.

The DHA seeks a secure, reliable data exchange platform that modernizes legacy services to scalable, cloud‑native, API‑driven, standards‑based, AI/ML‑ready capabilities for real‑time clinical and operational data sharing.
The solicitation is a Commercial Solutions Opening (Area of Interest 0002) with no set‑aside, posted for DHA and due on 28 October 2026.
DHA’s Enterprise Intelligence and Data Solutions Program Management Office (EIDS PMO) recently completed the largest data standardization and migration operation in the agency’s history.

rationale.point: The solicitation has no set-aside (claim #3), making it full and open competition; the median of top DoD awards under NAICS 541512 is $237M, far exceeding the company's largest past contract of $3.4M.

The required scope is a secure, scalable, cloud-native, API-driven, AI/ML-ready data exchange platform (claim #2), which exceeds the company's demonstrated experience in software maintenance and web portal development.

The company has only 22 staff and an active Secret facility clearance, but no evidence of capacity for a large-scale enterprise data modernization effort of the magnitude recently completed by DHA's EIDS PMO (claim #4).

risks: Large business dominance in full and open competition
Significant scope and scale mismatch with past performance
Insufficient staffing and relevant experience for enterprise-level data exchange modernization
Short timeline to proposal due date (2026-10-28) limits teaming options
nextSteps: Pursue set-aside opportunities (SBA, SDVOSB) aligned with NAICS 541512 and past performance
Explore subcontracting roles on similar large-scale data modernization efforts
Build relevant past performance through smaller cloud-native, API-driven projects
